project.name: nablatensor-jit-cpu
project.description: Bytecode-generating replay engine: the tape is emitted as a tape-specific class with the Class-File API (final since JDK 24) whose forward and reverse sweeps are straight-line bytecode, segmented to stay inside HotSpot C2 limits. No incubator module, no native library. The LTS-Java-clean default fast path.
